text:
In the dazzling city of Agrabah, a quick-witted street boy named Aladdin lived by his wits. He had no home or family, but he had a good heart, a clever mind, and his loyal monkey companion Abu.

Every day, Aladdin dreamed of a better life.

One day, a mysterious sorcerer gave Aladdin a mission: enter a magic cave and retrieve an old oil lamp. Aladdin ventured inside and found dazzling treasures — but he grabbed only the lamp as instructed.

When he tried to leave, the sorcerer betrayed him and sealed the cave!

Trapped in the dark, Aladdin accidentally rubbed the old lamp. With a thunderous BOOM, an enormous, shimmering blue Genie appeared!

"GREETINGS, Master! I am the Genie of the Lamp! You have THREE wishes. Choose wisely!"

"I wish to be free from this cave!" Aladdin cried. WHOOSH — he was out instantly! Then Aladdin used another wish to disguise himself as a prince to meet Princess Jasmine, who was tired of suitors interested only in her royal title.

Riding a magnificent magic carpet through the starry night sky, Aladdin showed Princess Jasmine the whole world. She laughed freely for the first time, and both their hearts soared.

But Aladdin was afraid — if she knew he was just a street boy, would she still care for him?

The evil sorcerer stole the lamp and used it to take control of the kingdom! "Genie, make me the most powerful ruler alive!" Aladdin had to act fast — without the lamp and with only one wish remaining.

Clever Aladdin tricked the sorcerer into overreaching his own wish — and used his final wish to free the Genie from the lamp forever! The sorcerer's power was broken.

Aladdin then told Jasmine the truth about who he really was.

"I don't want a prince," smiled Jasmine. "I want YOU — the real you." The Sultan, seeing Aladdin's courage and honest heart, welcomed him with open arms.

🌟 THE END 🌟

💡 Moral: An honest heart and brave spirit are worth more than any wish!
